name: Contact Center as a Service & Telephony Fabric
description: Cloud-native telephony and media fabric providing carrier connectivity, SIP trunking, session border control, WebRTC browser endpoints, dual-channel media forking, and multi-region failover.
roleInCenter: Carrier and media foundation: terminates PSTN and digital ingress, secures signaling and voice paths, records media streams, and guarantees multi-region availability.

glossary.definition: Session Initiation Protocol logical link connecting enterprise voice infrastructure to PSTN carriers over IP networks
Network edge appliance that secures, normalizes, and polices SIP signaling and RTP media streams between carrier and cloud
Browser-embedded real-time audio and signaling client eliminating desktop softphone hardware via SRTP and Opus codecs
Standardized active splitting of caller and agent RTP audio streams to recording, transcription, and voice biometric consumers
Automated DNS SRV and SIP options health switching across redundant telecommunications carriers when trunk degradation occurs
Multi-region cloud deployment where signaling state and ingress numbers route live traffic across geographically isolated availability zones
Media pipeline queue that smooths packet arrival variance to prevent choppy voice audio without adding excessive conversational delay
Cryptographic caller ID signing framework verifying calling party number authenticity across carrier hops
Public Switched Telephone Network number termination mapping dialed toll-free and direct inward dial numbers to cloud contact flows

metrics.name: Voice Mean Opinion Score (MOS)
metrics.definition: ITU-T perceptual audio quality score derived from packet loss, latency, jitter, and codec R-factor across active calls

metrics.name: Call Setup & Ingress Completion Rate
metrics.definition: Percentage of inbound PSTN and SIP invites that successfully establish media without carrier 5xx failure or dead-air drop

metrics.name: Post-Dial Delay (PDD)
metrics.definition: Elapsed time from final digit dialed to ringing or IVR media start across carrier and SBC hops

metrics.name: WebRTC Media Drop & Reconnect Rate
metrics.definition: Share of handled contacts experiencing mid-call audio loss or ICE transport renegotiation adding handling friction

metrics.name: Total Fabric Ingested Contacts
metrics.definition: Total voice and digital sessions terminated onto the CCaaS fabric across all ingress trunks and gateways

failureModes.name: One-Way Audio & Symmetric NAT Block
failureModes.signal: Agent hears caller or caller hears silence; short-duration agent disconnects and repeat redials spike
failureModes.mitigation: Enforce TURN relay fallback on WebRTC endpoints and validate symmetric RTP latching at the SBC

failureModes.name: SIP Trunk Concurrent Channel Exhaustion
failureModes.signal: Carrier returns SIP 486 or 503 busy signals during peak intervals while agents remain idle in ACD
failureModes.mitigation: Configure burst-elastic SIP trunk capacity and automated overflow across secondary carrier peers

failureModes.name: Silent Recording & Stream Fork Failure
failureModes.signal: Completed interactions lack dual-channel audio in QA and real-time co-pilot transcripts stall mid-call
failureModes.mitigation: Enable continuous RTP packet-count telemetry on SIPREC forks with automated switchover to backup media recorders

failureModes.name: Remote Agent Last-Mile Jitter Degradation
failureModes.signal: MOS drops below 3.5 for specific remote agents; talk-over and repeat verification requests increase AHT
failureModes.mitigation: Enable Opus FEC packet recovery, DSCP QoS tagging, and pre-shift WebRTC network readiness checks
